guideline_boundary: Recommendations are panel/guideline assertions using author_conclusion plus guideline_recommendation tags. Cited study effects are secondary reports anchored to this chapter and tagged secondary_reported_result; they are not represented as if this guideline enrolled participants.
schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; author_conclusion plus descriptive tags used.
QuantitativeResult supports a single numeric estimate and is primary-study-oriented; narrative ranges and table targets were preserved as other atoms rather than forcing artificial effect structures.
